reviews.affected_location: Interior of the g04 tabletop, between its long edges, oriented by the g12 window wall.
reviews.gs_evidence: shot3/e14 is supported in all six frames, IoU 0.679, size [0.148,0.192,0.081], and depth MAD 0.041. Original pixels establish tabletop support despite uncertain metric height.

visual_evidence.observation: Pale blue packet rests on the interior tabletop with a conspicuous upright white tissue.
The corresponding exposed interior tabletop shows continuous wood grain without a blue packet or upright white tissue; the held red book is above and toward the person.
The same interior surface is unobstructed and contains neither packet nor tissue.

reviews.counterfactual_test: Keeping the packet at its target tabletop contact would expose at least the upright white tissue in both source frames. The candidate contact region and surrounding uncertainty margin are visibly bare.
reviews.alternative_explanations: Introduction or relocation between observations explains the difference. The empty original pixels exclude detector omission, and the person, mug, and cup do not cover this interior region.
reviews.reason: The table boundary and radiator-facing side orient the support plane. Remaining depth and corner uncertainty do not move this interior packet into an occluded region in both witness frames.

reviews.affected_location: Central tabletop near the pencil cup, toward the chair's working area.
reviews.gs_evidence: Target packet size is approximately 0.148 × 0.192 × 0.081, with depth MAD 0.041. No trusted transform maps its low envelope into shot1.

visual_evidence.observation: Pale blue packet and protruding white tissue are exposed on the tabletop.
Exposed central tabletop contains no visible blue packet or white tissue.
Hands, red book and pencil cup occupy or obscure parts of the possible central support region.

reviews.counterfactual_test: A reverse presence conflict needs two source frames in which the packet's mapped diagnostic part must be visible. The final source frame is clear, but a second guaranteed unobscured mapped region is not established.
reviews.alternative_explanations: Earlier source occlusion by the book, hands or cup remains possible within mapping and depth uncertainty.
reviews.reason: The visible difference is suggestive, but the required two-frame directional occupancy witness is incomplete.

reviews.affected_location: Interior of g04's tabletop, inward from its window-facing long edge identified using g12; the shot3 packet contact maps into the exposed central-right tabletop in shot1.
reviews.gs_evidence: shot3/e14 has original support in all six frames at [351,274,410,316], fused projection IoU 0.679, estimated size [0.148,0.192,0.081], and depth MAD 0.041. The model scale and systematic depth error are not bounded by that MAD. The occupancy test instead uses the visible tabletop contact and upright tissue, with g04 and g12 as independent local references; no global transform is claimed.

visual_evidence.observation: A pale blue packet lies on the interior tabletop with a conspicuous white tissue rising above it.
The same packet and upright tissue remain exposed at the same tabletop contact while the person is near the doorway.

The proposed interior region is exposed wood with continuous grain and reflections. The held red book and hands are above and toward the person; neither a blue packet nor an upright white tissue occupies this region.
The interior tabletop remains exposed to the right of the pencil cup. The standing person, hand and held book are to its left; no packet or tissue is visible.
With the person absent, the same tabletop region is unobstructed and bare.

reviews.counterfactual_test: In the reverse direction, retain the shot3 packet at its tabletop contact. The table perimeter supplies the support plane and long/short axes; the radiator/window-wall side resolves the tabletop's side ambiguity. The corresponding interior region in shot1 is exposed in frames 48, 72 and 120. At least the protruding white tissue, as well as exposed packet surface, must appear there. Instead the original pixels show bare wood.
reviews.alternative_explanations: Relocation or introduction between shots can explain the observations, so this is not global nonexistence. Earlier hand/book occlusion is real in some frames, but does not survive frames 48 and 72. The mug and pencil cup lie outside the necessary diagnostic region. Modest contact-depth or scale variation keeps the packet on the exposed interior surface; moving it behind those occluders would change its anchored tabletop placement.
reviews.reason: The first proposal is supported by the original pixels and by an additional clear intermediate frame, 72. The second proposal's concern about a missing second clear frame is resolved by frames 48 and 72. The mapping uses the table's visible perimeter together with the installed radiator to orient its window-facing side, not the tested packet or a symmetric tabletop alone. Metric reconstruction uncertainty does not permit an unchanged packet to avoid this exposed occupancy region. This is one localized reverse-direction presence conflict.

witnesses_a.observation: 两容器直立于同一桌面。绿杯完整杯身和杯底可见，笔筒口沿及上段露出；结合主体比例，笔筒下部虽被遮挡，其中心仍处于绿杯后侧。横向中心偏移小，沿桌心至暖气片方向所定义的u轴，绿杯减笔筒为负。
人物离开后相同关系保持。桌面连续，杯底清楚；若要反转u中心顺序，需让笔筒具有与可见口沿、直立筒身比例不符的隐藏延伸或横向偏心，单凭合理的杯把中心修正不足以实现。

witnesses_b.observation: 绿杯杯底与笔筒右侧下缘均可见，两者由同一桌面支撑。笔筒主体略偏右且支撑位置靠后；依据口沿、侧壁和底缘，而非只依据遮挡边，绿杯的前向位移足以超过横向偏移对u的贡献，中心差为正。
人物尚未接近容器，杯筒轮廓、底缘及位置与首帧一致。杯把虽使绿杯整体中心偏左，仍不足以抵消共同桌面上由可见底缘和直立主体支持的前后中心差。

verification.reason: 匹配的桌子与窗下暖气片提供同一物理锚点对，桌缘、窗墙及椅子位置支持参考对应，无需假定完整房间配准。两镜头各两帧的口沿、主体比例、底缘和共同桌面共同支持u中心差分别为负、正；结论不要求完整底面分离，也不把相机深度直接当作世界方向。合理的隐藏筒身延伸、杯把引起的中心偏移及锚点范围误差不足以反转这些局部顺序。相机变换时锚点与物理上方向共同变换，因此同一固定物理中心关系不能产生这两个符号。至少一个端点的放置不一致，不代表两物体都移动或精确交换位置。
verification.remaining_alternatives: 单目重建的距离、尺寸及差值幅度仍可能有误；压力区间不代表校准置信度。现有原图不支持足以消除符号冲突的合理中心或视角解释，亦不能确定具体哪一个容器移动。

penalty_semantics: Entity participation in confirmed contradictions, union of prior and relation endpoint groups, capped once per entity. A reversed pair contributes its two endpoint units; this does NOT prove both objects moved or an exact position swap.
limitations: This is an upper-bound score with unknown items unpenalized; read coverage and interval.
Local anchor-and-up relation comparison is not whole-scene registration.
Center/axis stress bounds are heuristic; visual grounding and anchor correspondence still use Codex.
Only relations with verified common support and sufficient geometric evidence can add penalties. Other spatial relations remain unassessed.
Entity participation measures affected structure, not which entity caused the error. No held-out human accuracy calibration.
